Concerns over voter list errors as new challenge faces Election Commission

Amidst concerns about voter names being omitted from electoral rolls, the Election Commission faces a new challenge related to the System for Electoral Roll Management (SIR). In Ranchi, a helpdesk is being established to assist voters with potential issues regarding their names on the list. This development raises questions about the SIR system and voter inclusion.
